name: Adsorption metal charge
description: Signed Bader charge on the adsorption metal; positive means electron deficiency.

name: Partner metal charge
description: Signed Bader charge on the other metal.

name: Adsorption metal spin magnitude
description: Absolute calculated atomic magnetic moment of the adsorption metal.

name: Adsorption metal: mean ligand spin magnitude
description: Mean of absolute atomic magnetic moments on the selected N/O/S neighbors.

name: Partner metal: mean ligand spin magnitude
description: Mean of absolute atomic magnetic moments on the selected N/O/S neighbors.

name: Metal separation
description: Cartesian separation between the two metals.

name: Adsorption metal: mean terminal ligand charge
description: Mean signed Bader charge of terminal ligands in this metal's shell.

name: Adsorption metal: net ligand dipole magnitude
description: Magnitude of the signed vector sum of ligand charge moments around this metal; includes directional cancellation.
